corrections.eligible_measurements: raw historical cleanliness and counts, labelled retrospective
corrections.rescore_command: none: the baseline is the record
corrections.title: Baseline: the paper record as measured before any 6B repair

corrections.eligible_measurements: post-boundary book_source/dirty_minutes classifications, read from the subscription's own gap rows
corrections.excluded_measurements: pre-boundary book_source/dirty_minutes classifications, which counted ordinary interleaving as dirty
corrections.title: Subscription continuity: the per-book seq check read multiplexed interleaving as a lost frame

corrections.eligible_measurements: post-boundary filled_contracts, anchored with the queue on both re-anchor branches
corrections.excluded_measurements: pre-boundary filled_contracts on any order that recovered from a dirty stretch
corrections.title: Recovery anchoring: the print floor was not anchored with the queue

corrections.eligible_measurements: post-boundary queue_remaining, reconciled against a trade inside its own horizon
corrections.excluded_measurements: pre-boundary queue_remaining and traded_at_price; the two are not comparable across the boundary, and traded_at_price is null afterwards
corrections.title: Trade and decrement reconciliation: a print and its own delta moved the queue twice

corrections.eligible_measurements: post-boundary fills clamped to the order's own expiry, and skip-reason counts re-attributed ahead of capacity
corrections.excluded_measurements: pre-boundary fills stamped after their order's expiry, and pre-boundary skip-reason counts, which C4 re-attributes
corrections.title: Expiry clamp and rejected-signal placement

corrections.eligible_measurements: post-boundary dirty_seconds/dirty_minutes scoped to the watched resting interval, with the counterfactual's own nw_dirty_seconds column and a bounded backoff on unreadable tickers
corrections.excluded_measurements: pre-boundary dirty_seconds/dirty_minutes on any cancelled or expired order
corrections.title: Dirty-time scope, observation coverage and counterfactual backoff

corrections.eligible_measurements: a range replay under the executor configuration in force over that range, sharing one capacity counter
corrections.excluded_measurements: pre-boundary single-variant replay counts as a baseline for a shared-capacity live loop. The population is resolved from the placed-order chain of the range, spec §1.6's parenthetical '(config_history by the range's runs)' not being implementable (config_history has no run column); that population is a lower bound on the executed set, because a configured variant that placed nothing in the range is invisible to it. A per-run exact comparison is out of scope.
corrections.title: Capacity-equivalent baseline replay
